content: Wasina bi Yawe God, Mosis iwonena mayeni bo,
“Isrel damdi kuwonedi da Tagu na Yawe yami God.

Gegha konabera da ware Ijipt damdi siyaberaberana, iiyawogha yadi kubure koya makamakena naboni, bo konabera da ware Kenen damdi siyaberaberana, iiyawogha yadi kubure akabimi tanaghonagho na naboni. Geyadi kedagha konanaghona.
Tagu na Yawe God, noko biidi yagu gwara da wonawiiyoyowana kokabisisiredi da konabera.
Memeda yagu gwara konakabisisiredi bi wonawiiyoyowana konabera, na yawa gwabidima konakabi, Tagu Yawe God.
Tagu Yawe God, na yagu sisiya kowaiyana, da getana iiyabo yana rakaraka ririne yawata sinimumuranana.
Gegha wasike nawaravi yakabikabi, bi yawata konimumuranana, basuna touna na dadabuna.
Gegha tomogha tana wavinena yawata konimumuranana - memeda naboni konabera na konidadabumi.
yana suwara gabugabuna gawarina debane. Tagu na Yawe yami God, bi memeda naboni konabera na kagu waghawagha konisinimayamayayi.
Gegha tomogha tana tomogha turana yawata sinimumuranana, mayimayiyina wasike teya; Mataguve na mmko ibero kirakii.
Gegha tomogha bo wasike tana ribiribi teya sinimumuranana, memeda naboni konabera na tami konadadabu.
Gegha mmkodi beradi konabera da konidadabumi. Basuna nokodi wawaya Kenen kubure samakamakena naboni sibera da mataguve na sidadabu, noko biidi na kuburinama ivikanibuvedi bi tami konarughu kamone.”

footnotes.text: Molek na Amon damdi yadi god.
